audience: webshops and logistics teams that ship parcels with a MyParcel account

useCases.title: Check the status of pending shipments
useCases.text: List the newest shipments, filtered by a text query or a status. Open one or more by id to see the recipient and status.

useCases.title: Follow a parcel with track and trace
useCases.text: Read the carrier scan history and status of one or more shipments. Use it to answer a customer question about delivery.

useCases.title: Show delivery dates at checkout
useCases.text: Read the delivery dates, delivery types and cut-off times for an address and carrier. List pickup points near the address.

useCases.title: Create a shipment for a new order
useCases.text: Create one or more shipments. Each shipment is billable and creates a label. The reply gives the new ids in the order sent.

useCases.title: Delete a shipment created by mistake
useCases.text: Delete one or more shipments by id. A shipment that was already handed to the carrier may not be deletable.
